description: This file is a Java source code for a Spring MVC controller named 'CategoryController' that manages CRUD operations, hierarchy, and listings for categories in a web application. It handles HTTP requests related to categories such as create, edit, save, delete, move, and list, and interacts with service classes for business logic.

classes.name: CategoryController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling CRUD, listing, and hierarchy management for Category entities in the admin panel.

methods.name: displayCategoryEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to edit an existing category by ID.

methods.name: displayCategoryCreate
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the create category form.

methods.name: displayCategory
methods.description: Internal method to prepare the model for displaying create/edit category form.

methods.name: saveCategory
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a category.

methods.name: displayCategories
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the list of categories.

methods.name: pageCategories
methods.description: Handles POST request for paginated category listing in JSON format.

methods.name: displayCategoryHierarchy
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the category hierarchy view.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a category by ID.

methods.name: moveCategory
methods.description: Handles POST request to move a category under a different parent.

methods.name: checkCategoryCode
methods.description: Handles POST request to check if a category code already exists.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set up menu attributes for views.
